description: Standard relation vocabulary for Beauty dataset (simplified)

relations.description: Type of beauty product (lipstick, skincare, haircare, nail_polish, perfume, wig, earrings, etc.)
Main color or shade (black, white, pink, red, gold, transparent, etc.)
Surface finish/sheen (matte, glossy, shimmer, satin, metallic, glitter)
Product texture (creamy, liquid, powder, gel, solid, mousse)
Packaging style, type and material combined (tube, jar, bottle, pump, compact, plastic, glass, luxury, minimalist)
Brand positioning (high_end, drugstore, natural_organic, trendy, professional, playful)
Intended use occasion (everyday, party, professional, special_occasion, wedding, travel)
Overall visual aesthetic (natural_beauty, sophisticated, youthful, artistic, bold)
Catch-all for anything not fitting above categories
